definitions.explanation: The release of gases, liquids, or substances, especially pollutants, into the environment.
The biological process of eliminating waste products from the body.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}からの{排出|はいしゅつ}ガスが{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Emissions from the factory have become a problem.

examples.japanese: {二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}の{排出|はいしゅつ}を{減|へ}らす。
{体内|たいない}の{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{排出|はいしゅつ}する。
examples.english: To excrete waste products from the body.

notes:
{排出|はいしゅつ} is used in both environmental and biological contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {排出|はいしゅつ}ガス - exhaust gas, emissions
- {排出|はいしゅつ}{量|りょう} - emission volume
- {排出|はいしゅつ}{基準|きじゅん} - emission standards
- {排出|はいしゅつ}を{削減|さくげん}する - to reduce emissions
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{排出|はいしゅつ}する - to excrete waste

SURU-VERB USAGE:
[substance]を{排出|はいしゅつ}する - to emit/discharge [substance]

RELATED TERMS:
- {排気|はいき} - exhaust
- {放出|ほうしゅつ} - release, discharge
- {汚染|おせん} - pollution
